# Coverage summary (historical)

**Status: superseded.** Do not cite this page for current coverage. Use [`coverage-matrix.md`](coverage-matrix.md), generated by `tools/build_coverage_matrix.py` from the canonical database snapshot, the 27-source transcript plan, the observation ledgers, the visual status and the Markdown inventory.

This page previously reported the pre-transcript state: 3 pilot series, 25 source-mapped expansion series, 44 DB-only series, and 2 of 27 broadcast days processed. Those numbers are out of date because the transcript pipeline later validated all 27 sources and consolidated 313 accepted observations.

- 72/72 match reports carry a database evidence block.
- 27/72 series have transcript coverage (24 complete, 3 partial); 45 are DB-only.
- 313 accepted transcript observations; 50 rejected; 5 resolved references.
- 9/9 team profiles, 21 hero pages, 6/6 strategy pages, 9 team briefs and 1 head-coach brief.
- 1 visual boundary verified (match 1062, DEWA vs ONIC; anchor DF3-w04d02-2465); the goal is complete under the revised first-visible-HUD standard (2026-11-24).

For the evidence-store decision, see [`evidence-store.md`](evidence-store.md).
